messages.subject: 5-a-side Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom - are you in for 5-a-side on Thursday at the Powerleague? We're a couple short and need to confirm the pitch by tomorrow. Pub after at the usual. Cheers, Marcus

(Sorry if this is the wrong Tom - I have two in my contacts!)
